# Keeping order records: four years after each sale

Keep each order record for at least four years after the sale [E-01]. That is the State of Example's own period.

## What the statute says

The State of Example's statute requires a business selling to consumers to keep each order record for at least four years after the sale [E-01]. The official text is current through the 2026 regular session.

## Why not seven years

One compliance summary site says most states require seven years [E-02]. That figure is about states in general, not about this state, so we do not recommend it as your rule.

## What to do

We recommend keeping every order record for four years from the date of the sale. Orders over 4,000 need the owner's approval [E-03], so keep that approval note with the order record for the same four years.

<!-- ow:internal -->
## Open questions
- Whether a later amendment changed the period: check the official text again after the next regular session.
